mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) from the previous month's value predicts positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to reduced discount rates and increased liquidity in the financial system.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines from the previous month, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index exceeds 320, it signals persistent inflation that leads to negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to the risk of further monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 320, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 1300) signals an overheating economy, leading to negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to the risk of aggressive monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1300, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth GDP regime (GDPC1 > 23700 billion), the S&P 500 is prone to negative 60-day forward returns due to the risk of monetary policy tightening and overvaluation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 23700, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) from the previous month's value predicts positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to stronger economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases from the previous month, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals an economic contraction that leads to negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 720000 million) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 1300) signals a robust economy, leading to positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to increased corporate earnings and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS > 720000 and HOUST > 1300, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that leads to negative 5-day forward S&P 500 returns due to immediate market reactions to rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
